title: Embedding verification suite for rerankers and scale testing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a reusable verification suite that evaluates embedding accuracy and reranker quality across model variants and scale scenarios. The suite should produce both offline quality metrics (Recall@k, MRR, MAP, cosine calibration, norm drift) and latency/throughput profiles under realistic batching and KV-cache-warmup behavior. It will drive automated drift alerts and provide artifact outputs (golden pairs, histograms, calibration curves) for the Console and Optimize teams.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly job that computes Recall@1/5/10, MRR, and MAP across a configurable set of golden test sets and temporal holdouts
Per-model and per-deployment report including cosine similarity histograms, embedding norm distributions, and a numeric drift score that triggers alerts when crossing thresholds
Synthetic perturbation generator to create adversarial and paraphrase variants for robustness measurements
Latency/throughput benchmark runner that simulates our production batching (continuous batching) and KV cache warmup and reports p50/p95/p99 latencies and tokens/sec
Artifacts (golden pairs, evaluation logs, and plots) exported to a stable S3 path and linked from a generated Confluence report
Integration with existing telemetry: metrics emitted to Prometheus/Grafana and a drift-alert webhook to the Platform reliability channel
tasks: Design golden set schema and storage layout (canonical pairs + metadata tags)
Implement offline evaluator: embeddings -> metrics -> artifacts
Create synthetic perturbation module: paraphrase, truncation, swap-entities, numeric-noise
Build latency benchmark harness that replays production request size distribution and warmup cache behavior
Add drift scoring algorithm (ensemble of KS-stat on norms, cosine mean shift, and retrieval-coverage drop)
Export visuals: calibration curves, histograms, and time-series drift plots
Hook evaluator into nightly CI pipeline and add feature flag for per-customer runs
Document runbook for triage and thresholds in Console and on-call playbook

notes: Decision: Use cosine similarity with length-normalized vectors for primary retrieval metrics to match production reranker behavior.

Trade-off: We will initially run the evaluator in a non-privacy-sensitive mode using synthetic and anonymized production samples. For customer-specific golden sets, require opt-in and KMS-backed storage.
Follow-up: Create small-footprint on-prem runner for private customers (ticket backlog).
